newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Trust announces property sales, stock loss.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Trust announces property sales, stock loss.

text.p: Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp announced on Friday that it would incur a special loss of 46.9 billion yen in the fiscal year through March 1997 from planned sales of real estate holdings in late March.
The bank also said in a statement that it would incur an appraisal loss of about 30 billion yen on its stock holdings due to the recent sharp decline in Tokyo stock prices.

Against this background, the bank said it had lowered its forecast for this fiscal year's parent net profit to 85 billion yen from its earlier estimate of 150 billion yen. It also lowered its parent current profit forecast to 130 billion yen from 150 billion yen.
